flipToBack.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction (singleton) on TriggerConditions.isTableChanged; auto-fires whenever condition holds
flipToBack.prose: Flip if your matching operatives control at least 3 battleground sites related to the Subjugated planet (control-with: you control the site AND at least one of your matching operatives is there; spotting includes cards excluded from battle).

children.req: controls-with >=3 locations (you control location, with your actor-filter card there)
children.gameConditions: GameConditions.controlsWith(game, self, playerId, 3, Filters.and(Filters.battleground_site, Filters.Subjugated_planet_location), SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE, Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.matchingOperativeToSubjugatedPlanet))

flipToFront.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction (singleton) on TriggerConditions.isTableChanged; auto-fires whenever condition holds
flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if you do NOT occupy at least 2 battleground sites related to the Subjugated planet. Plain occupy (any of your active cards provides presence, operatives NOT required), includes excluded-from-battle.

requirementSemantics: Front flip = CONTROL-WITH: player controls 3 distinct battleground Subjugated-planet sites, each requiring at least one of YOUR matching operatives there (actor-gated control).
Back flip = plain OCCUPY 2 (presence by any of your active cards; matching operatives NOT required to hold the back). Asymmetry: harder to flip than to hold.
'Subjugated planet' is runtime state: gameState.setSubjugatedPlanet(systemName) chosen at objective deployment (Card7_137.java:54-55); Filters.Subjugated_planet_location resolves against it.
typedIdentities: Filters.and(Filters.battleground_site, Filters.Subjugated_planet_location) - flip gate locations (both sides)
Filters.and(Filters.generic, Filters.site) - setup + per-deploy-phase download site
Filters.site - independent Tibrin Operative download to Tibrin while that operative is at a Tibrin site
Filters.or(Filters.Imperial, Filters.AT_AT) - back power +2 trigger companions
setupAndPullRoutes: Setup order 1 (Objective, required): deploy any planet system from Reserve Deck for free and without reshuffling; its system name becomes the Subjugated planet [Card7_137.java:46-56; DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect.java:41-45].

Setup order 2 (nested in the selected system's cardDeployed callback): deploy one generic site to that system for free and without reshuffling [Card7_137.java:58-64; DeployCardToSystemFromReserveDeckEffect.java:31-35].

Later Objective source, once during each owner deploy phase: deploy one generic site to the Subjugated planet; this overload is not flagged free and reshuffles [Card7_137.java:83-98; DeployCardToSystemFromReserveDeckEffect.java:21-23].

Tested operative source, independently once during each owner deploy phase: Tibrin Operative at a Tibrin site may deploy one site (Filters.site, not generic-only) to Tibrin and reshuffle [Card7_047.java:65-83]. No source order exists between this action and the Objective action.
otherObligations: Back: opponent's Force drains are -1 everywhere (ForceDrainModifier(self, Filters.any, -1, opponent)). Card7_137_BACK.java:66
Back: your matching operatives on the Subjugated planet are forfeit +2. Card7_137_BACK.java:67
Back: those operatives are power +2 when at same site as an Imperial or AT-AT. Card7_137_BACK.java:68-69
Back (optional trigger): retrieve 1 Force whenever you deploy a matching operative to a Subjugated planet location. Card7_137_BACK.java:74-94
Back (once per battle): add one battle destiny when your matching operative participates in a battle on the Subjugated planet. Card7_137_BACK.java:97-119

profile.frontStructuredRule: preFlip/flip allOf: self controlsWith >=3 Subjugated_planet_battleground_site using matchingOperativeToSubjugatedPlanet
profile.runtimeGeography: The selected Subjugated planet is read from gameState. Candidate sites are projected through the exact source-card deploy filter at that planet.
profile.formationLaw: Each counted site needs a matching operative plus another legal source of presence or ability because the operative's own ability is excluded from control on its matching planet.

behaviorProof.setup: At the Light-side setup prompt, both public facades choose Tibrin (three matching operatives) over Dantooine (zero), then choose a source-projected legal battleground site. The test asserts the winners, not the numeric score.
behaviorProof.pull: Public Light-side decisions use the Objective and Tibrin Operative sources once each, in either order, to reach three usable route sites. An opponent-occupied incomplete third site keeps the route open. After flip, an operative, but not the Objective, pulls a third legal site to buffer the two-site hold.
behaviorProof.deploy: Public Light-side decisions deploy three one-Force matching operatives and three one-Force companions with six Force and trigger the unchanged 7_137 flip. The planner requires exact engine deployability, actual modified payments, and safe weapon-adjusted contact.
behaviorProof.crossPhase: Public Light-side tests cover movement, battle, one real Force-loss choice, contested battle-Force continuity after the pair plan completes, and exact modified movement-Force continuity. Battle-forfeit is a synthetic CombinedEvaluator fixture; contested post-flip blocker and casualty cases are direct analyzer checks.
behaviorProof.sourceProjection: Direct analyzer tests reject a source-illegal site and a legal non-battleground site, allow the operative source to stand at a matching non-battleground site, and prevent a matching operative pilot from laundering excluded control ability through its vehicle. Setup uses the source's free projection; later pulls use their paid projection.
behaviorProof.parity: Every public behavior decision is compared between Rando and Chosen One. All five paired production files match after package normalization.
behaviorProof.verification: The focused family, engine, policy, and deploy-script gate passes 77 tests. The bounded neighboring regression gate passes 179 tests, for 256 current tests with zero failures. JSON validation and normalized mirror checks pass; package proof is recorded separately when run.
